numerical_regression.scope: Reduced actual CPU fits on original small-input profile, not a full production rerun or GPU test.

engineering_history: Windows denied the first whole-directory rename before any source move; tracked members were subsequently relocated individually from a preserved inventory.
A restricted multiprocess formatter stalled; single-process formatting succeeded. The exact stalled formatter PID/start time/command were verified before its retirement.
The first numeric comparison included random invocation UUIDs and wall times. Its report is retained; final comparison explicitly excludes only timing/UUID metadata.

Private renderer QA path/glob errors and partial exports were retained. A continuation consumed the previously bound strict 7+60 E5 packet set and completed only missing plots. No scientific source, gates or fits were changed.
limitations: Exact equality applies to the declared reduced CPU inputs. Full-study/GPU numerical replication was not performed during this layout change. Existing paper precision, finite-query and pilot-selection caveats remain.
